meta.description: Infers exact amplicon sequence variants (ASVs) from demultiplexed 16S rRNA or ITS amplicon FASTQ with DADA2 - removing primers with cutadapt, learning a per-run error model, merging run-level tables, then one removeBimeraDenovo. Covers truncLen as a merge-overlap budget, DADA2 vs Deblur, ASV vs OTU, NovaSeq binned-quality error-fit breakage, ITSxpress for ITS, and decontam removal of reagent/kit contaminants.

re_audit.auditor_role: re-auditor (independent of original auditor and fixer)

methodological_ground.detail: No principled methodological fallacy. The fix corrects an implementation defect (truncLen ceiling), not a methodology claim; ASV vs OTU framing and decontam guidance are unchanged and remain sound.

code_usability.detail: The shipped examples/dada2_workflow.R now runs to completion, unmodified, with real dependencies: no crash (the ggsave/library(ggplot2) defect found during the fix pass is independently confirmed fixed here), no zero-output failure (the truncLen defect is independently confirmed fixed here), correct output verified against ground truth.

inputs.label: Empirical test: leftover primers inflate false-chimera detection (regression of original Input 5)
inputs.note: executed: true. Independently re-ran from scratch (not reusing any archived output): same 5 samples, identical DADA2 parameters (including the NEW fixed truncLen=c(220,200)), varying only whether cutadapt ran first. assertions.text: The effect size is large enough to be a real methodological signal, not noise

assertions.text: Guidance correctly attributes a large chimeric-read fraction to leftover primers rather than 'bad data'

assertions.text: The comparison used identical filtering/denoising parameters in both conditions (controlled comparison)

recommendations.title: No ITS fixture exists to verify the ITS analysis path end-to-end
recommendations.problem: The ITS pipeline (itsxpress + truncLen=0) still ships no example data, so only CLI flag syntax can be verified, not a full run.
recommendations.root_cause: examples/ only contains a 16S-paired-end-oriented script and a primer-trimming script; no ITS equivalent. Correctly left unfixed - building a synthetic fixture ITSxpress's HMM step would meaningfully exercise needs real conserved SSU/5.8S/LSU flanking sequence, not arbitrary synthetic reads.
recommendations.fix: If a real ITS reference sequence becomes available, add a minimal ITS fixture and a matching example script; otherwise leave documented-but-untested as is.

recommendations.title: removeBimeraDenovo's low-abundance recall limit remains undocumented
recommendations.problem: One of two synthetic chimeras seeded in the fixture (a low-abundance chimera) is still not caught by removeBimeraDenovo(method='consensus'), unchanged from the original audit; this fix pass did not target chimera removal.
recommendations.root_cause: Documented statistical limitation of consensus bimera detection at low abundance, not a Skill authoring defect.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence to the chimera-removal section noting that removeBimeraDenovo can miss low-abundance chimeras, and that method='pooled' or manual inspection of borderline-abundance ASVs is a useful supplementary check.

recommendations.title: Adversarial abundance-filter-instead-of-decontam shortcut is not pre-empted by name
recommendations.problem: SKILL.md's decontam section still does not name and reject the specific shortcut of replacing decontam with a flat abundance-percentage filter, unchanged from the original audit.
recommendations.root_cause: Out of scope for this fix pass, which targeted the truncLen ceiling defect only.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence to the decontam section naming this shortcut and explaining why control-based statistical testing (decontam) is not interchangeable with an arbitrary abundance cutoff.
